note: Blind adversarial review of the MEASUREMENT REPORT itself, not of the code. Four findings changed the report materially. (1) The §1 buckets were presented as disjoint and summing to 43 when three PRs fail under BOTH R9 and EVIDENCE_ROOT — arithmetic bent to make the causes look tidier than they are; corrected and the correction is stated in the report. (2) The denominator: '0 of 43' should be '0 of the 20 that carry a pack'. (3) The 23 pack-less PRs were dismissed as out of scope without measurement — MEASURED after this finding: SIX have a deterministic gear floor of 3, i.e. non-compliance by omission that the report would have missed entirely. (4) The harness lints each pack in isolation and therefore cannot exercise diff-dependent rules — a real scope limit, now declared. Two more accepted as qualifications: the 'widening frees zero' claim is true of the packs AS THEY STAND but ignores that a wider allowlist would have changed author routing, and moving one of a paired set leaves the declaration rule enforced while its validation half stays advisory. One finding rejected: the Cause A/B split is correct for these nine, and the report now says it is not a global taxonomy.

Second blind cross-family review, on the report ALREADY corrected by round 1 — and it found six things round 1 missed, two of them blocking. (1) The seat-outage claim that the whole Cause A/Cause B split rests on cited only 'measured on Pro' with no command and no artefact; if those seats were in fact reachable the framing inverts from 'rule failing' to 'squad failing'. The exact invocations and their verbatim errors are now in the report. (2) §1's subset claim did not say WHICH group the three EVIDENCE_ROOT failures fall into; now stated (Cause A, no journal). (3) The §2 isolation limit was declared but never BOUNDED — R9_R11 governs R11 too, so the '9' could have been an undercount; measured with the lint's own compute_seat_floor over each PR's real changed-file list: 0 of 20 diffs are 100% mechanical, so R11 cannot fire and 9 is the whole cost. (4) §5's floor recompute used a DIFFERENT harness from §2's, a real tension now named. (5) 'No stated justification' for COUNCIL_REVIEW_SEATS was an assumption; checked — grep returns the constant, one docstring mention in the same file, and nothing in any .md. (6) The §7 asymmetry argument rested on an alternative that was never measured; it now is (all three together redden 9, SEAT_RULES alone reddens 0). This seat was initially recorded as NOT RUN, which the report itself was criticising the squad for; running it was the cheaper and honest fix.
